name: Fort Hospital
player_description: The hospital runs along the south side of the fort. Valeria the medicus runs it with unsettling efficiency. The beds are clean, the instruments are clean, and the patients who arrive here either leave walking or leave on a stretcher.
gm_notes: Valeria knows every injury in the fort. She is the best source of information about physical altercations, suspicious wounds, and who has been visiting whom at night. DC 13 Medicine check opens her as an information source. DC 15 Insight: she is watching the party specifically -- someone asked her to.
